svg.aria-label: 2 versions of the plate after step 2, side by side. Left, correct: row 1 reads 31.25, 37.5, 37.5, 31.25 and row 2 reads 6.25 in each interior cell. Right, without the halo: row 1 reads 25, 31.25, 31.25, 25 and row 2 reads 0; every differing cell is outlined in red. Block boundaries are drawn as thick lines, showing that each wrong cell has a neighbor in another block.
svg.text: Every cell whose neighbor belongs to another block loses that neighbor.
Thick lines: borders between blocks of 2 × 2.
Red: 8 wrong cells, each with a neighbor
